jynxzi.reaction_signature: Sudden pitch spikes, dramatic deadpan pauses before screaming, rapid chair-lean into mic, rhetorical callouts to chat.
jynxzi.optimal_hook_0_3s: Open on the exact blunder, taunt, or absurd visual frame; let the 0.25s silence breathe before the scream lands.
jynxzi.pacing_rules: Keep clips tight (20-38s). Preserve 0.25s Synchresis pauses before punchlines; avoid cutting his stutter-emphasis cadence.
jynxzi.caption_vocab_notes: Preserve slang accurately ('bad aim', 'clipped', 'no shot', 'bro'). Never transcribe 1-letter stutters alone.
jynxzi.framing_and_cover_style: High-contrast expressive face reaction on top webcam card; 2-3 word impact headline ('NO WAY', 'INSTANT KARMA').
jynxzi.bounty_fit: High CPM velocity on TikTok, YT Shorts, and IG Reels (strong DM shareability).

xqc.bounty_fit: Top Tier-1 EN retention and high Kick 1080p60 VOD availability.
